setupLinkedin.title: LinkedIn setup required
setupLinkedin.message: LinkedIn cannot be collected until its scraping integration is configured.
setupLinkedin.action: Ask an administrator to configure the Apify API token, then run the pipeline again.

setupIntegration.title: Additional setup required
setupIntegration.message: This source needs an external scraping integration.
setupIntegration.action: Ask an administrator to configure the Apify API token, then run the pipeline again.

setupXSearch.title: X search setup required
setupXSearch.message: This source needs a search integration to discover public posts.
setupXSearch.action: Configure Google Custom Search or Apify, then run the pipeline again.

setupSearch.title: Search setup required
setupSearch.message: This source needs a search integration to discover public posts.
setupSearch.action: Configure Google Custom Search or Apify, then run the pipeline again.

invalidSource.title: Invalid source
invalidSource.message: The source address or type is not recognized.
invalidSource.action: Check the source format and update it before the next run.

notFound.title: Source not found
notFound.message: The account or page does not exist, was renamed, or is no longer public.
notFound.action: Check the spelling or URL, then update or remove this source.

notFoundX.title: X account not found
notFoundX.message: The account or page does not exist, was renamed, or is no longer public.
notFoundX.action: Check the spelling or URL, then update or remove this source.

rateLimited.title: Temporarily rate limited
rateLimited.message: The platform temporarily limited collection requests.
rateLimited.action: Wait a while and run the pipeline again.

accessBlocked.title: Access blocked
accessBlocked.message: The platform rejected requests from the scraper's current network.
accessBlocked.action: Try authenticated access or a scraping proxy, then run the pipeline again.

authenticationFailed.title: Authentication required
authenticationFailed.message: The configured credentials were missing, rejected, or expired.
authenticationFailed.action: Check the integration credentials and run the pipeline again.

serviceUnavailable.title: Platform temporarily unavailable
serviceUnavailable.message: The source platform returned a server error.

timedOut.title: Request timed out
timedOut.message: The source did not respond within the allowed time.
timedOut.action: Try again; if it continues, review the network or timeout configuration.

connectionFailed.title: Connection failed
connectionFailed.message: The scraper could not establish a reliable connection to this source.
connectionFailed.action: Check the URL and network connection, then try again.

sourceUnavailable.title: Source unavailable
sourceUnavailable.message: The source is private, protected, deleted, or otherwise unavailable.
sourceUnavailable.action: Confirm that the source is public or remove it from the project.

noResults.title: No articles found
noResults.message: The source was reached successfully but produced no usable articles in this run.
noResults.action: Check the project date window and source activity before trying again.

httpError.title: Source could not be fetched
httpError.message: The source returned HTTP {{status}} and could not be collected.
httpError.action: Try again later or review the source configuration.

fetchFailed.title: Source could not be collected
fetchFailed.message: An unexpected problem prevented this source from being collected.
fetchFailed.action: Try again; if it continues, review the technical details.

fetchNotes.blocked: Blocked (HTTP {{status}}) - likely anti-bot protection against this server's network, not a problem with the source itself.
fetchNotes.httpError: HTTP {{status}} - the source's page could not be fetched.
fetchNotes.telegramUnavailable: Telegram channel unavailable (private, not a channel, or missing).
fetchNotes.tweetUnavailable: Could not fetch this tweet (deleted, private/protected, or fxtwitter.com is unavailable).
fetchNotes.apifyMissing: {{platform}} sources require Apify, and the Apify API token is not set.
fetchNotes.unknown: The source could not be fetched. Review the technical details.
